title: 2026 Christmas Shipping Deadlines for Ecommerce Sellers
summary: USPS, UPS and FedEx list 2026 Christmas ship-by dates by service. Allow for processing and pickup times when setting customer order cutoffs.
body_markdown:
The United States Postal Service (USPS), UPS, and FedEx have published 2026 Christmas shipping schedules to help ecommerce sellers plan fulfillment.


For the lower 48 states, USPS[recommends](https://www.usps.com/holiday/holiday-shipping-dates.htm) December 17 for Ground Advantage®, December 18 for Priority Mail®, and December 19 for Priority Mail Express®.


UPS[lists](https://assets.ups.com/adobe/assets/urn%3Aaaid%3Aaem%3Ae8548535-8096-4fa9-9cef-2b81aef7c26c/original/as/year-end-holiday-schedule-us-en.pdf) December 21 for 3 Day Select®, December 22 for 2nd Day Air®, and December 23 for Next Day Air®, targeting December 24 delivery. Ground dates depend on the route. Some destinations may require earlier UPS ship dates. Check estimates before setting customers’ delivery expectations.


FedEx[lists](https://www.fedex.com/content/dam/fedex/us-united-states/services/2026_Peak_Last_Day_to_ship.pdf) December 15 for Ground Economy®, December 21 for Express Saver®, December 22 for 2Day®, and December 23 for overnight services, targeting December 24 delivery. Ground and Home Delivery® dates vary by route.


For ecommerce sellers, these schedules help determine order cutoffs after allowing for your own warehouse processing. Delivery depends on destinations, acceptance times, and service conditions.


Set customer order deadlines that allow for picking, packing, and carrier handoff. Confirm transit estimates and pickup availability, update checkout messaging, and check separate guidance for international and offshore shipments.
